# Food pantry route consolidation

The Alder Falls Community Pantry, which runs a book swap shelf in the Main Street branch lobby, merged its two grocery delivery routes this spring. The route consolidation means one truck now covers both the north and south sides of town on Tuesdays and Fridays.

Volunteers said the hardest part was moving drop-off times for families who had kept the same slot for years. The pantry asks library staff to post the new schedule flyer near the book swap shelf.
